author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Added a new 'Employee Directory' tab — searchable list of active employees, click one to see their full Employment card (start date, tenure, next anniversary, position, team, supervisor, employment type, hours, contact info, benefits). Also fixed 9 HR Dashboard insights (PTO Balances/Requests, Bonus Records, Overview Counts, Disciplinary Actions, Exit Checklist Status, Job Applications Funnel, Onboarding Status/Checklists, Employee Directory lookup) that were scoped to a single user instead of the whole workspace — these would have shown empty/broken panels for anyone but that one user.
